'''Lamm:''' {{legend0|#7996e2|50–60%}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Ben Nighthorse Campbell]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = [[Ben Nighthorse Campbell]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} {{ElectionsCO}} The '''1998 United States Senate election in Colorado''' was held November 3, 1998. Republican incumbent [[Ben Nighthorse Campbell]] won re-election to a second term by a [[Landslide victory|landslide]] over former Colorado first lady [[Dottie Lamm]]. As of {{CURRENTYEAR}}, this is the only time since [[1968 United States Senate election in Colorado|1968]] that a Republican won the Class 3 Senate seat in Colorado, and the last time that a Native American was elected to the United States Senate until [[2022 United States Senate special election in Oklahoma|2022]]. == Background == [[Ben Nighthorse Campbell]], who was elected in 1992 on the Democratic ticket, switched parties after the "[[Republican Revolution]]" in the [[1994 United States elections]]. == Democratic primary == === Candidates === * [[Dottie Lamm]], former Colorado first
